structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Placement of substance in Schedule II
law.text:
The Board shall place a substance in Schedule II if it finds that:
The substance has high potential for abuse;
The substance has currently accepted medical use in treatment in the United States, or currently accepted medical use with severe restrictions; and
The abuse of the substance may lead to severe psychic or physical dependence.
